correctness.rationale: Shortest graph-distance paths between distinct ports of length at most two cross at most one reversal matching edge; triangle-freeness forces at most two projected vertices. Port-fiber diameter at most two gives simplex vertex fibers. In each base-edge fiber, every nonbridge port is dominated by its incident bridge port, giving explicit collapses to an edge. The finite-poset fiber theorem proves the integral homotopy equivalence. Scale-one internal triangles occur only at degree three; collapsing them leaves a graph with canonical primitive degree-four/five local-cycle kernel. At degree six the star truncation collapses to VR(C6,2)=boundary of a three-cross-polytope S2. The code independently verifies 39 finite examples and the sharpness obstruction but is not the unlimited proof.
